name: TC-DOWNLOAD-E2E: Complete Report Download Dialog, Advance Filters, Excel Generation & Verification Flow
description:
Single-session verification of the Report Download flow:
1. Authenticate and navigate to Report listing
2. Click 'Download Report' on Overall Summary row and verify Advance Filters dialog
3. Configure filters: Assigned To, Partner Name, Generated By, and Date Range
4. Trigger Excel generation and poll until status is 'Completed' with 'XLSX'
5. Download Excel file to disk and verify file validity and size
